CustomField.description: Idempotency means that processing the same request twice has the same effect as processing it once. Inbound: the framework checks for a duplicate Idempotency-Key header and returns the cached response without running the request again. Outbound: a key is built as a SHA-256 hash of the endpoint, the request parameters and the body, and sent as the Idempotency-Key header; a retry is safe only if the remote system honours that header, and two calls with identical endpoint, parameters and body share a key.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Inbound: a duplicate request with the same Idempotency-Key header returns the original response instead of running again. Outbound: a key built from the endpoint, parameters and body is sent as the Idempotency-Key header, which lets a call that got no response be retried safely when the external system honours the header. A key the call already carries, such as one given with withIdempotencyKey, is sent instead.
CustomField.label: Idempotency Enabled
